definitions.explanation: A guest of high status or importance, treated with special respect. Used in formal and diplomatic contexts for VIP visitors.

examples.japanese: {賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A special seat was prepared for the distinguished guest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国賓|こくひん}→国賓：12137_kokuhin⟧や{賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}→晩餐会：13094_bansankai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A banquet welcoming state guests and distinguished visitors was held at the palace.

notes:
Composed of {賓|ひん} (guest of honor) and ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest, visitor). A formal word used in diplomatic, governmental, and ceremonial contexts. Everyday usage would sound stilted; ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧ or ⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧ are more common alternatives depending on the context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome honored guests
- {賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to invite distinguished guests
- {賓客|ひんきゃく}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for honored guests

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧: guest of honor — used for invited guests at ceremonies, graduations, and formal events
- ⟦{国賓|こくひん}→国賓：12137_kokuhin⟧: state guest — specifically a foreign head of state visiting officially
- {貴賓|きひん}: distinguished guest — very formal; seen in {貴賓室|きひんしつ} (VIP room)
